dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 06, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**ROCKETS BLAST OFF: Yankees and Nationals Lead the Way in Thrilling MLB Action**

In a day filled with explosive offense, the Tampa Bay Rays were no match for the Yankees' Ben Rice, who blasted his 25th homer of the season on a fly ball to right center field. Rice's power display was matched by José Caballero, who went deep twice and drove in four runs to lead the Yankees to a 5-1 victory.

Meanwhile, in Washington, the Nationals' Yainer Diaz and Brice Matthews fueled their team's 11-12 comeback win over the Astros. Matthews hit his seventh homer of the season on a line drive to left field, while Diaz scored on the play. Diaz also went deep earlier in the game, and his efforts helped set the stage for the Nationals' thrilling comeback.

In other action, the Arizona Diamondbacks dominated the San Diego Padres 8-0 behind a strong outing from Brandon Pfaadt, who tossed five scoreless innings with six strikeouts. Nolan Arenado also went deep for the Diamondbacks, hitting his 10th homer of the season on a fly ball to left field.
